title: Call: Heritage Days Committee Chair — Ticket List

transcript.speaker: Hollis Bagley
transcript.text: Hi, good morning. This is Hollis Bagley with the Heritage Days Committee. I'm the chair. I'm sorry, I don't know who I'm supposed to talk to, so I hope this is the right line. My phone has been ringing since six this morning.

transcript.speaker: Hollis Bagley
transcript.text: Three of our volunteers are sick. Throwing up, the runs, one has a fever. And a couple of the school families have called me too, the ones who came with the teachers' tables. Everybody says it started Sunday. Everybody ate at the supper Saturday night.

transcript.speaker: Hollis Bagley
transcript.text: So here's what I've got. We have the ticket list. Four hundred twelve sold, with names, phone numbers, and the table number each party sat at, because we did assigned seating this year. And then our twenty-six volunteers, I have them on a separate sheet. I'm happy to send all of it to you. Who do I send it to?

transcript.speaker: Hollis Bagley
transcript.text: And the other thing. Should I just email all the ticket holders myself this morning and tell them to see a doctor if they're sick? I've got most of their emails from the ticket sales. I already have it typed up, I was going to send it before ten. People are calling me, not you, and I feel like I should tell them something.

transcript.speaker: Hollis Bagley
transcript.text: Okay. And you'll want to know who made the food. Prairie Table did the cooking, all of the hot food. The cake came from a baker over in Dunmore, a big sheet cake. And the coleslaw and the pasta salad came from the produce people in Kessler. I don't have their numbers in front of me but Prairie Table would.

transcript.speaker: Hollis Bagley
transcript.text: All right. You've got my cell, five five five, oh one nine one. Just tell me what you need.

voiceStyles.Hollis Bagley: Volunteer committee chair in their 60s, warm small-town voice, talking fast and a little rattled, wants to be helpful and to do something right now
voiceStyles.MCHD: Health department staff member at a desk phone, calm and professional

instructorNote: This call gives players the cohort denominator (412 ticket holders and 26 volunteers, with table numbers for a seating map) and puts pressure on them because the chair is ready to email attendees before 10:00. Watch for the DIR to ask the committee to hold its message until MCHD sends an approved notice, for the ticket list to go to the Nurse Manager so no names reach the shared line list, and for DIR/EPI to call this Level 2 for now (7 of 11 ED cases linked). They should also note that 10 or more linked cases, or any hospitalized linked case, triggers Level 3 under outbreak plan section 4.
